topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: Receiving a package meant for the last occupant is a curious affair, a thread of the past woven into the fabric of my present. The envelope, crinkled with transit, bears a name unfamiliar yet destined for these very hands. It's a momentary connection to a stranger, a brief glance into a life once lived here. The contents, whatever they may be, are a secret wrapped in the tape and paper of another's history. Yet, here I am, the unintended guardian of this parcel, pondering what small piece of the world it holds and whether there's a duty to send it back into the stream of its intended journey.
